iko.text: The Ozolith crystal formation appears outside Drannith, spawning a new era of wild mutation, and Vivien and Lukka trace the changes to it, where Lukka learns he can control the mutated monsters.

At the Battle at the Ozolith, Lukka touches the central crystal and is pulled into a vision, and the Ozolith pulses and turns the nightmares on the hunters, so a great snake drags the skyship Vermilion down.
Lukka returns transformed and announces he controls the monsters, and when he tries to seize Zeph and Rol, Vivien hurls him away and the bonders flee while he assembles an army of nightmares.
Corrupted by the Ozolith, Lukka marches his monster army on Drannith, and the Ozolith explodes, severing him from his beasts and igniting his planeswalker spark.
